test_layer_stack_equivalence: test that layer_stack produces identical outputs to an unrolled loop of Haiku layers
test_layer_stack_multi_args: test layer_stack with a function that takes multiple arguments and returns multiple outputs
test_layer_stack_varargs_error: test that layer_stack raises a ValueError when the inner function uses varargs
test_layer_stack_gradients: test that layer_stack gradients match the equivalent unrolled stack across different unroll values
test_layer_stack_with_state: test layer_stack with per-layer state threading using the with_state flag
